title: My cybersecurity and cloud learning goal

claim_boundary.statement: I am publishing a learning intention and an evidence route. I am not claiming completion, mastery, a credential or professional experience.
claim_boundary.safe_scope: I will use the fictional or dummy evidence and the safe boundaries stated in each lab.
claim_boundary.tool_limit: A matching helper result can check an expected decision or format; it cannot judge my reasoning or prove independent skill.

status_model.planned: I have selected the lab and its prerequisites, but I have not claimed an attempt.
status_model.guided: I have worked with instructions, examples or prompts and recorded that help.
status_model.solo: I have preserved a first answer to a changed case before checking a reference.
status_model.reviewed: A person has challenged my evidence and reasoning, and I have retained the feedback and correction.
status_model.recall: I have tried different facts later without reusing my earlier answer.

review_gate.statement: Before I start a dependent lab, I will keep reviewed or equivalent evidence for each named dependency.
review_gate.unavailable_reviewer: I will mark the work awaiting review and will not call it independently demonstrated.

stages.title: Make bounded decisions
stages.complexity: I will use small fictional records to practise one bounded decision at a time.
stages.mastery_note: This label describes exercise complexity, not my current ability.

evidence.decision: I will name the owner, targets, allowed actions, exclusions, time window, stop conditions and pending approval.

evidence.artifact: I will retain a synthetic packet worksheet with exact frame references and stated capture limits.
evidence.decision: I will match each DNS question to any visible reply by endpoints, ports, DNS ID, name and type; distinguish an A answer, NXDOMAIN and no visible reply; use only the supplied synthetic evidence rather than claim a live capture; and not treat the exercise as proof of packet loss, application success, answer truth, professional use, completion or mastery.
I will preserve required access while removing permissions without a stated business need.
I will separate rule matches, interpretation and the next evidence request.
I will cite exact event records and state uncertainty in a short handover.
I will show route matches, the selected next hop and what the path cannot prove.

evidence.artifact: TCP flow table with exact frame references and sequence/acknowledgement calculations
evidence.decision: I will use the supplied synthetic packet summaries to distinguish an observed handshake, reset, no visible response, missing final ACK, missing initial SYN and acknowledgement mismatch; cite exact frames and show sequence/acknowledgement calculations; and state that the excerpt cannot establish full connection state or root cause, that missing packets do not prove packet loss, firewall failure or server fault, that an observed handshake does not prove application success, and that matching helper results do not prove professional use, completion or mastery.

evidence.artifact: I will retain a saved-scan-to-inventory table with exact IP address, TCP port and XML references.
evidence.decision: I will compare the supplied synthetic scan snapshot with the approved inventory; distinguish hosts not present, recorded down or unregistered and expected, missing or unexpected open TCP services; and state that the offline helper does not run a scan. I will not treat one saved snapshot or a matching result as proof of ownership, vulnerability, malicious activity, current state, complete coverage, professional use, completion or mastery.

evidence.artifact: I will retain a fictional finding-priority queue with exact record and field references, impact, exposure, evidence-of-use, service-importance and confidence inputs, each four-part score, any overriding rule, uncertainty and the next owner check.
evidence.decision: I will apply only the supplied local rubric to supplied fictional findings: unverified evidence becomes investigate; supplied fictional observed-exploitation records become urgent; otherwise I will assign urgent, planned or routine by score. I will state that the rubric is not CVSS, queue labels do not set deadlines, proof of concept does not prove exploitation, and helper matches do not prove a real vulnerability, real exploitation or current risk, professional use, completion or mastery.

evidence.artifact: I will retain a fictional component/advisory worksheet citing component IDs, package names, versions, scope, path evidence, advisory IDs, affected-range comparisons, uncertainty and the next check.
evidence.decision: I will compare each supplied stable three-part version numerically with every supplied exact-package [introduced,fixed) range; distinguish no supplied advisory from outside supplied ranges; and separate build exposure from reachable, not-demonstrated and unknown runtime paths. I will state that this offline exercise trusts the supplied inventory and path evidence and does not install packages, fetch live notices, resolve a full dependency chain, model ecosystem-specific version rules or test an exploit. Version, range and helper results do not prove exploitability, safety, professional use, completion or mastery.
I will record required traffic kept, excess traffic removed and the model limits.

evidence.artifact: HTTP triage report and evidence note
evidence.decision: I will separate observed requests, possible explanations and the next check.
I will classify exact changes as approved, unexpected or unsupported by the baseline.
I will use retention, required scope, byte hashes and RPO, then state the check's limits.
I will cite record IDs, preserve my first prediction and name the next unanswered check.
I will explain each keep, remove or review decision from the supplied evidence.

stages.title: Connect controls and evidence
stages.complexity: I will combine earlier reasoning across cloud, identity, network, telemetry and recovery records.
stages.mastery_note: This label describes exercise complexity, not my current ability.

evidence.artifact: I will retain a synthetic account-control worksheet with exact evidence references and stated limits.
evidence.decision: I will compare supplied enrolment, enforcement, recovery, ownership, monitoring and emergency-access records with the lab rules, then state that the helper does not test a real sign-in or prove control effectiveness.
I will distinguish successful actions, denied attempts, coverage gaps and attribution limits.
I will name the responsible party, agreement evidence, control record, gap and next owner.
I will distinguish allow, explicit deny and implicit deny and compare one copied policy change.
I will trace issue, expiry, revocation and action decisions without overclaiming attribution.

evidence.artifact: Two-leg cloud path diagram and reachability table
evidence.decision: I will trace addressing, route choice, inbound rules and untested assumptions.

evidence.artifact: Import report, rejected-record list and reconciliation note
evidence.decision: I will link normalised and rejected rows back to their source evidence.
I will show expected records, arrival times, heartbeat evidence, gaps and the smallest next check.
I will compare copied and verified hashes, measured durations and the restored version with the baseline.

evidence.artifact: Dummy-file evidence register and copy receipt
evidence.decision: I will link each copy to its recorded source, compare source and copy hashes, record UTC handling gaps and state what those records cannot prove.

evidence.artifact: I will retain a DEMO-only secret exposure worksheet and evidence note.
evidence.decision: I will trace only exact listed markers through configuration, saved changes and logs, distinguish active and revoked values, keep response proposals bounded and state what the supplied files cannot prove.

stages.title: Build and communicate a case
stages.complexity: I will connect several evidence types while keeping alternative explanations, authority and audience boundaries visible.
stages.mastery_note: This label describes exercise complexity, not my current ability.

evidence.decision: I will cite parent, location, signature and change context without asserting malware.
I will state the time-window rule and avoid treating alert counts as incident counts.

evidence.artifact: Saved SQL and expected/actual result tables
evidence.decision: I will reconcile distinct-event counts and explain any join multiplication.
I will build a timeline, two hypotheses, evidence needs and a bounded handover.
I will name authority, operational effect, evidence preservation, owner and release check.

evidence.artifact: Staff message, technical handover and manager update
evidence.decision: I will separate confirmed facts, hypotheses, gaps, actions and owners for each audience.
